meta.title: Art Hotel Vlora — Boutique Hotel on the Albanian Riviera
meta.description: Modern boutique hotel in Vlorë, Albania. Seaside views, elegant rooms, and warm hospitality. Book direct via WhatsApp and save 10%.

hero.subtitle: Boutique Hotel on the Albanian Riviera
hero.heading: Where Modern Elegance Meets the Sea
hero.description: Experience the beauty of Vlorë from our newly designed boutique hotel. Stunning sea views, contemporary comfort, and authentic Albanian hospitality.

discount.title: Book Direct via WhatsApp
discount.description: Skip the booking fees. Message us directly on WhatsApp and enjoy an exclusive 10% discount on your stay.

rooms.title: Our Rooms

standardDouble.name: Standard Double
standardDouble.description: Comfortable double room with modern furnishings and city or partial sea view. Perfect for couples or solo travelers.

standardTwin.name: Standard Twin
standardTwin.description: Spacious twin room with two single beds, ideal for friends or colleagues traveling together.

deluxeDouble.name: Deluxe Double
deluxeDouble.description: Upgraded double room with premium amenities, balcony, and panoramic sea view.

deluxeTriple.name: Deluxe Triple
deluxeTriple.description: Generous room with flexible bedding for up to 3 guests. Features a private balcony with sea view.

deluxeFamily.name: Deluxe Family Suite
deluxeFamily.description: Our largest room, perfect for families. Spacious layout with separate sleeping areas, full sea-view balcony, and premium amenities.
